_readme: Reviewed equivalences between versions of scripts/audit_jev_calibration.py (the Jev audit runner), read by scripts/export_jev_calibration.py check_combinable. Reports from two runner versions are pooled into one export only when their scoring files (scripts/jev_classifier.py, medlang_circuits/jev_client.py) are identical AND their runner versions are equal or linked here. The runner selects the turns it scores and builds each one's user turn and prior context (evaluate_petri_classifier), so a change there changes the measurement and must never be listed. List a pair only after reading the diff between the two runner versions and finding it touches orchestration alone (command-line flags, spend accounting, checkpoints, report writing), with the reason and the date of the review. Each entry: evaluator_sha256 and equivalent_to (sha256 of the runner file at each version, as resolve_classifier reports them in source_reports), from_commit and to_commit (where each version is found), reason, reviewed_utc. Empty until such a review is made (Codex review of PR #111, 2026-10-14).
